record.body:
## Evidence

1179 deselected on the -m tmux pass; exit code 5. All other legs pass.

## Consequence

Advisory only. Landing is not blocked by this suite fail. The human finding suite-command-tmux-pass tracks the config edit.

## Follow-up

A human drops the tmux pass from settings.conductor.phase_gate.suite.command in .canon/config.json.

payload.basis: exit_code 5 on the last leg. The three real pytest legs passed (268, 134, 1179 tests). The configured command ends with pytest -m tmux, which collects nothing now that the tmux marker is gone.
payload.invalidated_when: suite check-run passes at phase head, or human clears
